notes.title: Update v1.0.1 — Optimization, Gamma Settings & Xbox Support
notes.notes:
Hi, guys!

Today we're releasing update v1.0.1 — it addresses key issues based on your feedback:
⚙️ Improved optimization across different graphics quality levels.
📋 Updated menu — navigation is now more intuitive and user-friendly.
🎛️ Added gamma adjustment option.
🎮 Xbox gamepad support is now available.
🐞 Fixed various bugs, including crashes and freezes.

We're continuing to work on the game — a new update is already on the way.
Thank you for staying with us!

Your team,
Sinka Games

notes.title: Release postponement: our first bug and a bit of a reschedule
notes.notes:
Hi friends!

We wanted to share some important news with you. Unfortunately, we had to postpone the release date of our game. During the final stage of testing, we encountered a critical bug that we still can't figure out. It took us all day yesterday to find the cause, but so far to no avail.

We are very sorry to have to report this at the last minute. We are new to game development and this is all a great experience for us. We want our first game to be as good as possible, so we will try to sort out the problem as soon as possible.

We'll keep you informed and we'll be sure to tell you as soon as we have new information. Thank you very much for your patience, support and understanding - it is very important for us!

Sincerely, Sinka Games Team
